source_files.handler_inventory_observation: The pinned handler glob contains 72 tracked TypeScript files: 60 concrete UiHandler subclasses represented below and 12 explicit exclusions above. The inventory is sorted and compared exactly once by the local Node check.

menu_kinds.name: Message
source_observations: BattleMessageUiHandler owns the MESSAGE mode prompt callback and consumes ACTION/CANCEL only while awaiting the prompt.
EvolutionSceneUiHandler and EggHatchSceneUiHandler reuse Message prompt behavior while adding scene skip/cancel rules.
Message-derived screens may also implement cursor grids; that inheritance does not make their normal grid input actionable to the co-op probe.
menu_kinds.mapping_note: Descriptive source classification only; no Rust type is proposed.

menu_kinds.name: Confirm
source_observations: ConfirmUiHandler is an option list with yes/no callbacks and an optional full-party variant.
Form and modal handlers use SUBMIT for submit callbacks and CANCEL/back through their opener rather than a yes/no list.
menu_kinds.mapping_note: Descriptive source classification only; no Rust type is proposed.

menu_kinds.name: ChoiceList-like
source_observations: AbstractOptionSelectUiHandler provides skipped options, optional virtual scrolling arrows, delayed input, noCancel, keepOpen, and ACTION/CANCEL selection.
Title, autocomplete, settings option select, save-slot management, and several data-driven screens implement list-like behavior with source-specific cursor rules.
menu_kinds.mapping_note: Descriptive source classification only; no Rust type is proposed.

menu_kinds.name: Command
source_observations: CommandUiHandler owns the battle command grid and routes FIGHT/BALL/POKEMON/RUN/TERA/RESET to phase callbacks or mode transitions.
FightUiHandler is the command's move-grid continuation and returns to COMMAND on cancel except for the mystery encounter path.
menu_kinds.mapping_note: Descriptive source classification only; no Rust type is proposed.

menu_kinds.name: Replacement
source_observations: PartyUiHandler's SWITCH, FAINT_SWITCH, POST_BATTLE_SWITCH, and REVIVAL_BLESSING modes select a party slot; FAINT_SWITCH and REVIVAL_BLESSING suppress cancel.
TargetSelectUiHandler selects move targets with non-wrapping grid navigation and a callback on ACTION.
menu_kinds.mapping_note: Descriptive source classification only; no Rust type is proposed.

menu_kinds.name: Interaction
source_observations: Mystery encounter, ER quiz, ER map, ER map picker, ER bargain, biome shop, colosseum, and community/Showdown screens expose callback-driven interactions with source-specific disabled and resolved states.
The ER map picker has no cancel path: only revealed destination nodes are selectable and ACTION resolves the route.
menu_kinds.mapping_note: Descriptive source classification only; no Rust type is proposed.

menu_kinds.name: Waiting
source_observations: ModifierSelect blocks normal input until reward/shop animations and tutorial gating finish.
Message text animation, egg hatch/gacha animations, loading/session modals, option-list delay, and ER bargain's opening/speaking guards consume or reject input by time/state.
menu_kinds.mapping_note: Descriptive source classification only; no Rust type is proposed.

menu_kinds.name: Terminal
source_observations: GameStats, RunInfo, EggList/EggSummary, Pokedex pages, and completed tournament views are read-only or back-oriented screens with no general submit action.
Terminal-like does not imply one cursor model: the sources use page cursors, scroll helpers, nested overlays, or callback-driven back behavior.
menu_kinds.mapping_note: Descriptive source classification only; no Rust type is proposed.

handler_behaviors.cursor_model: Two-level cursor: All/category/voucher navigation, then a vertically scrolling achievement grid.
handler_behaviors.wrapping: Navigation enters/leaves the grid at edges; grid vertical movement wraps within the available list.
handler_behaviors.disabled_option_handling: Category and voucher data determine displayed/locked content; no generic skip flag is used in the handler.
handler_behaviors.submit_action_behavior: ACTION enters the focused section or returns from the grid; SUBMIT is not a separate branch in processInput.
handler_behaviors.cancel_back_behavior: CANCEL reverts the UI mode.
handler_behaviors.owner_source: src/ui/ui.ts registry entry for UiMode.ACHIEVEMENTS; normal input is dispatched by UiManager to the active handler.
handler_behaviors.actionability_source: Inherited MessageUiHandler actionability: active && isAwaitingPromptAction(). Local processInput independently handles achievement-grid/navigation input; no additional co-op readiness override is present.

handler_behaviors.cursor_model: No handler-owned directional cursor; DOM/modal controls own focus.
handler_behaviors.wrapping: Not applicable to handler input.
handler_behaviors.disabled_option_handling: The supplied buttonActions and form state decide whether a control can complete; handler does not filter a choice list.
handler_behaviors.submit_action_behavior: FormModalUiHandler invokes submitAction on SUBMIT and consumes it when the callback is present.
handler_behaviors.cancel_back_behavior: CANCEL/ACTION are not normal keyboard submit paths; modal button callbacks and clear/revert own dismissal.
handler_behaviors.actionability_source: Inherited active state; actual form readiness is DOM/input dependent.

handler_behaviors.cursor_model: AbstractOptionSelect cursor over filtered autocomplete options; text-entry modal owns typing focus.
handler_behaviors.wrapping: Uses AbstractOptionSelect directional behavior among unskipped options.
handler_behaviors.disabled_option_handling: Filtered/skip options are excluded by the base option list; typing modal controls whether selection is available.
handler_behaviors.submit_action_behavior: ACTION and CANCEL are explicitly swallowed for typing safety; SUBMIT reaches the base only in AUTO_COMPLETE mode and invokes the selected option.
handler_behaviors.cancel_back_behavior: CANCEL is swallowed while the modal is active, so dismissal is owned by the text/modal layer.
handler_behaviors.actionability_source: AbstractOptionSelect active && !blockInput, with the subclass's typing guard affecting processInput.

handler_behaviors.cursor_model: Nine-row form: status, target, machine, four voucher rows, save, cancel; voucher rows have their own toggle state.
handler_behaviors.wrapping: Vertical cursor clamps at row ends; horizontal controls step/toggle according to the focused row.
handler_behaviors.disabled_option_handling: Voucher affordance and target/machine limits are rendered from source state; save is the commit row.
handler_behaviors.submit_action_behavior: ACTION toggles voucher rows, changes controls, or commits the save row and invokes saveSystem before reverting.
handler_behaviors.cancel_back_behavior: CANCEL and the cancel row revert the mode without committing.
handler_behaviors.actionability_source: Inherited MessageUiHandler actionability: active && isAwaitingPromptAction(). Independently, local processInput applies the handler's custom readiness/animation state guard.

handler_behaviors.cursor_model: Vertical ball list plus a final cancel row; cursor remembers the selected ball row only for the active display.
handler_behaviors.wrapping: UP/DOWN wrap through ball rows and the cancel row.
handler_behaviors.disabled_option_handling: Unavailable ball rows remain visible; ACTION plays an error and does not dispatch the command.
handler_behaviors.submit_action_behavior: ACTION on an owned ball invokes the command phase with BALL, returns to COMMAND, then MESSAGE; ACTION on cancel row returns to COMMAND.
handler_behaviors.cancel_back_behavior: CANCEL always returns to COMMAND; the cancel row has the same back behavior.
handler_behaviors.owner_source: src/ui/ui.ts registry entry for UiMode.BALL; command phase callback owns the resulting battle action.
handler_behaviors.actionability_source: UiHandler active state; no separate readiness override.

handler_behaviors.cursor_model: No directional cursor; prompt callback state and optional level-up/IV subprompt state.
handler_behaviors.wrapping: Not applicable.
handler_behaviors.disabled_option_handling: Input is ignored unless awaitingActionInput and onActionInput are both set; text animation can defer the prompt.
handler_behaviors.submit_action_behavior: ACTION invokes the awaiting callback; SUBMIT is not handled by this source processInput.
handler_behaviors.cancel_back_behavior: CANCEL invokes the same awaiting callback; otherwise it is unhandled.
handler_behaviors.actionability_source: MessageUiHandler.isCoopV2InputActionable: active && isAwaitingPromptAction(). Local processInput consumes ACTION/CANCEL only when the prompt callback is armed.

handler_behaviors.cursor_model: Shop item grid cursor over valid layout cells; overlay hiding can deactivate the handler and later restore it.
handler_behaviors.wrapping: Directional movement only reaches valid grid neighbors; no wrap at edges.
handler_behaviors.disabled_option_handling: Stock and affordability dim the rendered cell, but ACTION still calls the selected item callback; phase/shop validation owns rejection.
handler_behaviors.submit_action_behavior: ACTION invokes the selected item callback with its index, including source-visible unaffordable/sold-out cells.
handler_behaviors.cancel_back_behavior: CANCEL invokes the callback with -1.
handler_behaviors.actionability_source: UiHandler active state; hidden overlay sets active false.

handler_behaviors.cursor_model: DOM form focus; no handler cursor.
handler_behaviors.wrapping: Not applicable.
handler_behaviors.disabled_option_handling: Form validation and submit callback decide availability.
handler_behaviors.submit_action_behavior: SUBMIT invokes the configured submit action through FormModalUiHandler.
handler_behaviors.cancel_back_behavior: CANCEL is not a form submit; modal callback/clear owns dismissal.
handler_behaviors.actionability_source: Inherited modal active state; DOM validity is dynamic.

handler_behaviors.cursor_model: Header/start/list model with a scrollable challenge list and a start bar; options are edited on the focused challenge.
handler_behaviors.wrapping: List movement scrolls through visible rows; header/start transitions are source-specific and do not form a generic ring.
handler_behaviors.disabled_option_handling: Challenge constraints and DOUBLES/TRIPLES exclusivity reject or adjust incompatible selections; saved last setup is a source-data shortcut.
handler_behaviors.submit_action_behavior: ACTION/SUBMIT on header apply setup; ACTION on start begins or reuses a challenge run.
handler_behaviors.cancel_back_behavior: CANCEL backs out of header/start/list according to current focus and eventually reverts.
handler_behaviors.actionability_source: Inherited UiHandler actionability: active. Local processInput independently applies the challenge header/list/start and readiness checks; this plain UiHandler does not inherit MessageUiHandler prompt actionability.

handler_behaviors.cursor_model: DOM form focus; no handler cursor.
handler_behaviors.wrapping: Not applicable.
handler_behaviors.disabled_option_handling: DOM validation and the configured submit callback decide whether the password change can complete.
handler_behaviors.submit_action_behavior: SUBMIT invokes the form submit callback.
handler_behaviors.cancel_back_behavior: CANCEL/back is owned by modal callbacks and clear/revert.
handler_behaviors.actionability_source: FormModalUiHandler active state; DOM readiness is dynamic.

handler_behaviors.cursor_model: Two-choice cursor: CONTINUE and CASH_OUT.
handler_behaviors.wrapping: LEFT/RIGHT toggles the two choices without wrapping beyond the endpoints.
handler_behaviors.disabled_option_handling: Resolved state blocks further selection; callback/phase decides whether a choice is valid.
handler_behaviors.submit_action_behavior: ACTION invokes the callback with the selected choice and marks the interaction resolved.
handler_behaviors.cancel_back_behavior: CANCEL resolves as CASH_OUT.
handler_behaviors.actionability_source: UiHandler active plus resolved guard.

handler_behaviors.cursor_model: Battle command grid with FIGHT/BALL/POKEMON/RUN, conditional TERA, and RESET; cursor remembered per field slot.
handler_behaviors.wrapping: Grid edges are clamped/no-op; conditional TERA/RESET occupy source-specific special positions.
handler_behaviors.disabled_option_handling: TERA is rendered only when available; POKEMON/RESET and phase conditions decide whether callbacks can act.
handler_behaviors.submit_action_behavior: ACTION dispatches FIGHT, BALL, POKEMON, RUN, TERA, or RESET to phase/mode callbacks; SUBMIT is not separately handled here.
handler_behaviors.cancel_back_behavior: CANCEL invokes phase.cancel.
handler_behaviors.owner_source: src/ui/ui.ts registry entry for UiMode.COMMAND; fieldIndex is supplied by battle phase.
handler_behaviors.actionability_source: UiHandler active state; phase conditions determine whether selected commands resolve.

handler_behaviors.cursor_model: Scrollable field-row cursor over name/subtitle/description/difficulty/rules/species/publish.
handler_behaviors.wrapping: UP/DOWN wrap across all rows; LEFT/RIGHT adjust difficulty/rule rows and are no-ops for text/publish rows.
handler_behaviors.disabled_option_handling: Empty/invalid fields are rendered and validated at publish; rule values can be OFF and may be bounded by the challenge definition.
handler_behaviors.submit_action_behavior: ACTION/SUBMIT opens text/species overlays or confirms/publishes the draft; publish validation can keep the screen open with inline errors.
handler_behaviors.cancel_back_behavior: CANCEL reverts immediately when clean, otherwise opens CONFIRM to discard edits.
handler_behaviors.owner_source: src/ui/ui.ts registry entry for UiMode.COMMUNITY_CHALLENGE_CREATE; CommunityChallengesUiHandler opens it as an overlay.
handler_behaviors.actionability_source: UiHandler active state; text/species/publish validation and overlay state are dynamic.

handler_behaviors.cursor_model: Sidebar nav cursor plus featured-card cursor; focus is nav or cards and the active section changes the feed.
handler_behaviors.wrapping: Sidebar and card cursors wrap; async feed replacement resets/clamps card selection to zero.
handler_behaviors.disabled_option_handling: Empty/coming-soon sections accept no card launch; async section results are ignored after disposal or section change.
handler_behaviors.submit_action_behavior: ACTION/SUBMIT activates the focused nav item or launches the focused challenge through onLaunch; published attempts may be recorded first.
handler_behaviors.cancel_back_behavior: CANCEL calls the opener's onBack callback when supplied, otherwise revertMode.
handler_behaviors.owner_source: src/ui/ui.ts registry entry for UiMode.COMMUNITY_CHALLENGES; Title/Profile opener supplies callbacks.
handler_behaviors.actionability_source: UiHandler active state; feed availability and disposal are dynamic.

handler_behaviors.cursor_model: AbstractOptionSelect cursor over YES/NO, or SUMMARY/POKEDEX/YES/NO in full-party mode; remembers switchCheck cursor.
handler_behaviors.wrapping: Uses option-list directional wrap over unskipped options.
handler_behaviors.disabled_option_handling: noCancel and delay are supplied by show args; blockInput rejects during delay, and full-party options are source-created.
handler_behaviors.submit_action_behavior: ACTION invokes the selected option callback and clears unless keepOpen.
handler_behaviors.cancel_back_behavior: CANCEL selects the final unskipped option unless noCancel; while delayed and cancellable it releases the delay guard.
handler_behaviors.actionability_source: AbstractOptionSelectUiHandler active && !blockInput.

handler_behaviors.cursor_model: Voucher-row cursor plus horizontal gacha machine cursor; multiplier/edit and summary states add nested cursors.
handler_behaviors.wrapping: Voucher rows are bounded; machine navigation is source-specific; editing and animation states capture input.
handler_behaviors.disabled_option_handling: Voucher counts and animation state determine whether a pull is available; unavailable actions play error/are ignored.
handler_behaviors.submit_action_behavior: ACTION selects a voucher, starts/advances gacha, confirms multiplier, or dismisses summary according to state.
handler_behaviors.cancel_back_behavior: CANCEL cancels/fast-forwards animation, exits editing, dismisses summary, or reverts from the gacha screen according to state.
handler_behaviors.actionability_source: Inherited MessageUiHandler actionability: active && isAwaitingPromptAction(). Independently, local processInput applies animation/editing state guards.

handler_behaviors.cursor_model: No cursor; scene phase skip state and Message prompt state.
handler_behaviors.wrapping: Not applicable.
handler_behaviors.disabled_option_handling: For ACTION/CANCEL, the current EggHatchPhase.trySkip result gates the scene skip; otherwise the delegated Message handler applies its own prompt readiness.
handler_behaviors.submit_action_behavior: There is no local SUBMIT branch: ACTION/CANCEL first try EggHatchPhase.trySkip(), then all buttons delegate to globalScene.ui.getMessageHandler().processInput(button).
handler_behaviors.cancel_back_behavior: CANCEL follows the same EggHatchPhase.trySkip()-then-message-handler delegation; there is no independent cursor/back branch.
handler_behaviors.actionability_source: Inherited UiHandler actionability: active. Local processInput separately tries EggHatchPhase.trySkip() for ACTION/CANCEL, then delegates to globalScene.ui.getMessageHandler().processInput(button); it does not inherit MessageUiHandler prompt actionability.

handler_behaviors.cursor_model: ScrollableGridHelper cursor over a 9-column egg grid.
handler_behaviors.wrapping: Grid helper owns row/column scroll and edge behavior.
handler_behaviors.disabled_option_handling: Empty/invalid egg cells are handled by the grid/data helper; handler does not expose a generic option skip list.
handler_behaviors.submit_action_behavior: Non-CANCEL input is delegated to ScrollableGridHelper; ACTION behavior is helper/data-defined.
handler_behaviors.cancel_back_behavior: CANCEL reverts the mode.
handler_behaviors.actionability_source: Inherited MessageUiHandler actionability: active && isAwaitingPromptAction(). Independently, local processInput delegates cell readiness and navigation to ScrollableGridHelper.

handler_behaviors.cursor_model: ScrollableGridHelper over a 9-column summary grid; exit is time-blocked briefly after show.
handler_behaviors.wrapping: Grid helper owns navigation; no explicit handler wrap policy beyond helper.
handler_behaviors.disabled_option_handling: CANCEL is rejected with an error during blockExit; grid cells are data-defined.
handler_behaviors.submit_action_behavior: Non-CANCEL input delegates to the grid helper; no independent submit callback.
handler_behaviors.cancel_back_behavior: After blockExit, CANCEL ends EggSummaryPhase; during the guard it is consumed/rejected.
handler_behaviors.actionability_source: Inherited MessageUiHandler actionability: active && isAwaitingPromptAction(). Independently, local processInput applies the EggSummary blockExit timer guard.

handler_behaviors.cursor_model: Offer list with optional CHECK TEAM and LEAVE rows; picker mode has selectable offer rows plus a virtual cancel.
handler_behaviors.wrapping: Normal offer movement is bounded/no-wrap; picker and speaking states use their own state-machine paths.
handler_behaviors.disabled_option_handling: Opening guard, carried-input guard, speaking state, and offer availability/requirements determine whether input is consumed or accepted.
handler_behaviors.submit_action_behavior: ACTION activates an offer/leave/check row, or confirms a speaking choice after the timer guard.
handler_behaviors.cancel_back_behavior: CANCEL leaves normal mode, cancels picker mode, or resumes from speaking according to state; no cancel is allowed during the initial guard.
handler_behaviors.owner_source: src/ui/ui.ts registry entry for UiMode.ER_BARGAIN; phase supplies offers and callbacks.
handler_behaviors.actionability_source: Custom override: active && elapsed >= 600ms && !speaking, or speaking after its >=250ms carried-input guard; readiness timer is separately announced to co-op.

handler_behaviors.cursor_model: DOM text input focus; no handler cursor.
handler_behaviors.wrapping: Not applicable.
handler_behaviors.disabled_option_handling: Field label, initial text, and validation/cap are supplied by the opener; DOM controls own editability.
handler_behaviors.submit_action_behavior: Form/modal SUBMIT returns the entered value through the configured button action.
handler_behaviors.cancel_back_behavior: Cancel button action returns to the opener without committing.
handler_behaviors.owner_source: src/ui/ui.ts registry entry for UiMode.COMMUNITY_CHALLENGE_TEXT; community and ghost editors open it as an overlay.
handler_behaviors.actionability_source: Modal/form active state plus DOM focus/validation.

handler_behaviors.cursor_model: Cursor indexes only revealed route nodes; hidden nodes render ??? and never enter selectable.
handler_behaviors.wrapping: UP/DOWN clamp at the first/last revealed node; no wrapping.
handler_behaviors.disabled_option_handling: Unrevealed nodes are visible silhouettes but excluded from selectable; resolved or empty-selectable states reject input.
handler_behaviors.submit_action_behavior: ACTION resolves the selected revealed biome, sets MESSAGE, and invokes onSelect once.
handler_behaviors.cancel_back_behavior: No CANCEL branch exists: the route must be selected to continue.
handler_behaviors.owner_source: src/ui/ui.ts registry entry for UiMode.ER_MAP_PICKER; route phase supplies nodes/origin/onSelect.
handler_behaviors.actionability_source: UiHandler active plus resolved/selectable-length guards.

handler_behaviors.cursor_model: View mode journey cursor or pick mode revealed-route cursor; the two modes use different actions.
handler_behaviors.wrapping: Journey view scrolls only while an adjacent node exists; pick navigation is bounded to revealed onward routes.
handler_behaviors.disabled_option_handling: Hidden/unrevealed route nodes are not selectable; resolved state blocks callbacks.
handler_behaviors.submit_action_behavior: View ACTION closes; pick ACTION travels via callback and returns to MESSAGE.
handler_behaviors.cancel_back_behavior: View CANCEL closes; pick CANCEL is swallowed because route selection is required.
handler_behaviors.owner_source: src/ui/ui.ts registry entry for UiMode.ER_MAP; map phase supplies view/pick data.
handler_behaviors.actionability_source: UiHandler active plus view/pick/resolved state.

handler_behaviors.cursor_model: Four-answer cursor over the quiz options.
handler_behaviors.wrapping: UP/DOWN are bounded/no-wrap.
handler_behaviors.disabled_option_handling: Resolved state blocks input; the quiz phase owns answer validity.
handler_behaviors.submit_action_behavior: ACTION invokes the answer callback with the selected index once.
handler_behaviors.cancel_back_behavior: CANCEL invokes the callback with -1.
handler_behaviors.owner_source: src/ui/ui.ts registry entry for UiMode.ER_QUIZ; quiz phase supplies callback and co-op cursor ownership.
handler_behaviors.actionability_source: UiHandler active plus resolved guard; co-op cursor sends are owner-gated by phase.

handler_behaviors.cursor_model: Tabbed effect list or tune-form cursor; effect rows and tune rows have independent cursors.
handler_behaviors.wrapping: Effect and tune vertical cursors wrap; tabs wrap; tune values clamp/step within source constants.
handler_behaviors.disabled_option_handling: Effect state distinguishes equipped/owned/buyable/locked; unavailable or unaffordable ACTION plays error and does not mutate state.
handler_behaviors.submit_action_behavior: ACTION equips/unequips/buys an effect or edits/resets/toggles a tune row; callbacks persist changes.
handler_behaviors.cancel_back_behavior: CANCEL exits effect mode or returns from tune to the effect tabs; final exit callback/revert is source-configured.
handler_behaviors.actionability_source: UiHandler active plus a 250ms opening carried-input guard; preview texture/timer state is dynamic.

handler_behaviors.cursor_model: No directional cursor; Message prompt and canCancel flag.
handler_behaviors.wrapping: Not applicable.
handler_behaviors.disabled_option_handling: Prompt is disabled until Message callback is armed; CANCEL additionally checks canCancel.
handler_behaviors.submit_action_behavior: ACTION delegates to the Message prompt callback.
handler_behaviors.cancel_back_behavior: CANCEL delegates to the prompt and marks the evolution cancelled only when canCancel is true.
handler_behaviors.actionability_source: Inherited MessageUiHandler actionability: active && isAwaitingPromptAction(). Independently, local processInput applies the canCancel guard for CANCEL.

handler_behaviors.cursor_model: Move grid with two columns and dynamic fifth-move support; cursor remembered per field slot.
handler_behaviors.wrapping: Arrow movement is bounded/no-wrap inside the move grid.
handler_behaviors.disabled_option_handling: Unavailable/disabled moves are phase/move-data validated; TERA state changes the selected command.
handler_behaviors.submit_action_behavior: ACTION invokes phase.handleCommand(move/tera); SUBMIT is not separately handled.
handler_behaviors.cancel_back_behavior: CANCEL returns to COMMAND, except mystery encounter input can skip directly to fight input.
handler_behaviors.owner_source: src/ui/ui.ts registry entry for UiMode.FIGHT; command phase supplies fieldIndex.
handler_behaviors.actionability_source: UiHandler active state; move/phase validity is dynamic.

handler_behaviors.cursor_model: Page cursor clamped from zero through the available stats pages.

handler_behaviors.disabled_option_handling: No option list; missing stat pages/data simply constrain maxCursorPos.
handler_behaviors.submit_action_behavior: ACTION/SUBMIT have no source action branch.
handler_behaviors.cancel_back_behavior: CANCEL reverts the mode.
handler_behaviors.actionability_source: UiHandler active state.

ownership_rules.evidence: src/ui/ui.ts constructs the handlers array in UiMode order and processInput dispatches to the handler for the current mode; setMode/setModeWithoutClear/setOverlayMode/revertMode own mode transitions.

ownership_rules.rule: The active handler is the local input sink only when UiManager's processInputInner reaches it; overlayActive, tutorial routing, and awaitable callbacks can intercept first.

ui-inputs.ts is a routing layer, not a universal button-to-action mapping: touch tries SUBMIT then ACTION, MENU and cycle buttons have mode/handler whitelists, and non-whitelisted buttons can open overlays or be ignored.
ownership_rules.evidence: src/ui-inputs.ts buttonTouch, buttonMenu, buttonCycleOption, buttonGoToFilter; src/enums/buttons.ts.

ownership_rules.rule: Battle command ownership belongs to the active phase callback after a handler accepts input.
ownership_rules.evidence: CommandUiHandler/FightUiHandler/PartyUiHandler call globalScene.phaseManager current-phase handlers for commands, switch, shift, reset, and move actions.

ownership_rules.rule: Mystery encounter selection is phase-owned: local MysteryEncounterPhase handles local choices; CoopReplayMePhase rejects non-owner input and forwards a guest choice to the host.
ownership_rules.evidence: src/ui/handlers/mystery-encounter-ui-handler.ts processInput and isCoopV2InputActionable; src/ui/ui.ts co-op ME pump/ready path.

ownership_rules.rule: The source does not expose one global cancel meaning. CANCEL is prompt acceptance for Message, a choice row for AbstractOptionSelect, phase cancel for battle command, a callback for ER/party interactions, or unhandled for some waiting/transport screens.
ownership_rules.evidence: Per-handler records above; Button.CANCEL branches are source-local.

ownership_rules.rule: Registry constructor/mode mismatches are observations, not normalized ownership: ModifierSelect is registered at MODIFIER_SELECT but constructed with CONFIRM; PokedexScan is registered at POKEDEX_SCAN but constructed with TEST_DIALOGUE.
ownership_rules.evidence: src/ui/ui.ts handler construction and the corresponding handler constructors.

actionability_rules.evidence: src/ui/handlers/message-ui-handler.ts override requires active && isAwaitingPromptAction; BattleMessage prompt generation/timers arm the callback.

actionability_rules.rule: Abstract option-list actionability is active and not blockInput; delay/no-options/skip state is local input behavior.
Party, MysteryEncounter, and ErBargain override actionability with their custom prompt/block/timer state; phase ownership remains a separate gate.
Modal/form handlers can be active while processInput is false or SUBMIT-only; active visual state is not proof of an actionable serialized button.
actionability_rules.evidence: ModalUiHandler.processInput always false; FormModalUiHandler handles SUBMIT only; AbstractBindingUiHandler waits for buttonPressed.

actionability_rules.rule: ModifierSelect has a source-level readiness/actionability mismatch: it blocks processInput until animation/tutorial readiness but inherits base active actionability rather than publishing the same readiness state.
actionability_rules.evidence: ModifierSelectUiHandler.awaitingActionInput usage, constructor, and absence of an actionability override.

actionability_rules.rule: ui-inputs.ts can route a button to a different surface than the active handler's ordinary processInput, including overlays, stat panels, menu, filter, and speed settings.

global_dependencies.behavior: Serialized controls are UP, DOWN, LEFT, RIGHT, SUBMIT, ACTION, CANCEL, MENU, STATS, CYCLE_SHINY, CYCLE_FORM, CYCLE_GENDER, CYCLE_ABILITY, CYCLE_NATURE, CYCLE_TERA, SPEED_UP, SLOW_DOWN, and DEV_CUSTOM. Meaning is mode-scoped.

buttonTouch tries SUBMIT then ACTION; buttonMenu handles mode-specific open/revert; buttonGoToFilter and buttonCycleOption use handler whitelists; speed buttons mutate settings and can refresh settings UI.

The handler registry is indexed by UiMode; transitionModes use transition animations while noTransitionModes do not; setMode, setModeWithoutClear, setOverlayMode, revertMode, resetModeChain, and mode chains determine ownership and back behavior.

Choice-list base: options can be skipped; maxOptions adds virtual scrolling; ACTION/CANCEL invoke the selected handler; CANCEL chooses the final unskipped option unless noCancel; delay blocks input; keepOpen can reblock after a handler.
Tutorial routing consumes ACTION/CANCEL only when onActionInput is armed, invokes the callback, and clears it.
Modal pointer buttonActions are callback-owned; form processInput handles SUBMIT and invokes submitAction, while ACTION/CANCEL are not normal keyboard submit paths.
Binding screens wait before listening, auto-close after a timeout, use LEFT/RIGHT to choose action/cancel binding, and use ACTION to bind/cancel; settings control lists own tab/cursor navigation.

Settings list cursors scroll/wrap through visible rows; LEFT/RIGHT wrap or clamp option values according to setting.clamp; confirmation opens MESSAGE plus CONFIRM; settings OptionSelect uses the common choice-list base.

Handlers generally accept input then invoke the active phase/opener callback; validity, phase state, field index, and callback return values are dynamic dependencies rather than UI-only disabled flags.
Egg and related grid screens delegate cursor edge/scroll behavior to helpers; save/history/community/tournament screens can replace their selectable domain asynchronously.

global_dependencies.source: DOM/forms, browser storage, timers, and transport
global_dependencies.behavior: Form focus/validation, localStorage/network feeds, delayed input/animation guards, WebRTC/coop messages, escrow/rendezvous, and texture loads all affect whether a visible control can currently be accepted.

unresolved_dynamic_behavior.behavior: ModifierSelectUiHandler is registered at UiMode.MODIFIER_SELECT but its constructor calls super(UiMode.CONFIRM); PokedexScanUiHandler is registered at POKEDEX_SCAN but ui.ts constructs it with UiMode.TEST_DIALOGUE.
unresolved_dynamic_behavior.impact: Do not infer a normalized Rust mode/owner from the constructor value; registry slot is the observed dispatch owner.

unresolved_dynamic_behavior.behavior: Message-derived screens such as Menu, Achvs, AutoEggRestock, EggGacha, Pokedex, and StarterSelect inherit the exact prompt-only predicate active && isAwaitingPromptAction() while their local processInput accepts ordinary cursor/actions; plain UiHandler screens such as GameChallenges and EggHatch are separate.
unresolved_dynamic_behavior.impact: The oracle records both processInput acceptance and the inherited actionability predicate; it does not flatten them.

unresolved_dynamic_behavior.behavior: ModifierSelect's animation/tutorial readiness is checked in processInput but is not reflected by an override of isCoopV2InputActionable.
unresolved_dynamic_behavior.impact: Co-op readiness and local input acceptance can disagree until the integration owner resolves the protocol adapter policy.
